facts.business: Mukka Proteins Limited manufactures and exports marine ingredients such as fish meal, fish oil, and fish soluble paste, and has diversified into insect-based products including insect meal, insect oil, insect compost, and humic acid for animal feed and agriculture.

segments.name: Marine Ingredients (Fish Meal, Fish Oil, Fish Soluble Paste)
Insect-Based Products (Insect Meal, Insect Oil, Insect Compost, Humic Acid)

capacity_or_capex.item: Axis Bank Term Loan for new Bangalore plant

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts

key_risks: Foreign exchange risk from international operations and exports
Commodity price risk (though disclosure noted as not applicable per SEBI circular)
Dependence on promoter personal guarantees for credit facilities

Mohammed Arif, Mr. K Mohammed Althaf, Mrs. Umaiyya Banu) have provided personal guarantees for multiple bank facilities including HDFC, SBI, Axis Bank, and Bank of Baroda.
